# Property listings site

*Client industry: real estate | Completed: 2025-06-27 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p08*

## The problem
The client was a real-estate agency with a slow WordPress site.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using server-rendered React pages, a statically typed frontend codebase, a relational database with proper migrations, cloud hosting on managed services. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project brought page load from 6s to 1.2s.
